title: Quantity Tag Tables
description: Top-level keys are unit strings from the `Unit` type union. Each unit's value is a map of scale-name → ordered tag table consulted by `Quantity.tag(scaleName?)` / `Quantity.fromTag(_, _, scaleName?)` / `Quantity.parse(_, _, scaleName?)`. Single-vocabulary units use `default` as the scale name by convention; multi-vocabulary units (e.g. `K` with color + thermal) name each scale explicitly. The FIRST scale defined for each unit is the auto-default for no-scale-name calls.

unitScales.description: Map of scale-name → tag table. Scale names are arbitrary strings (`default`, `color`, `thermal`, etc.).

tagTable.description: Ordered list of `{tag, threshold}` rows. Author rows in ascending-threshold order for readability; the loader sorts ascending regardless.

tag.description: The friendly tag string returned by `Quantity.tag()` when the value meets-or-exceeds this threshold.

threshold.description: The lower bound of the band, in canonical units. `Quantity.fromTag(tag, unit, scaleName)` treats this as the canonical numeric value.
